name: eidos
description: Eidos is an extensible framework for personal data management.

scripts.postinstall: electron-builder install-app-deps && node scripts/postinstall-sqlite-ext.cjs && node scripts/fix-node-pty-perms.cjs
scripts.prebuild: pnpm run native:electron && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/base build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/file-space build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-manifest build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-installer build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-state build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-surface-protocol build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-sdk build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-runtime build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/legacy-space-migration build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/electron-ipc build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/rawdata build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/client build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/graft-client build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/ext-server run build:assets && node scripts/build-cli-local.cjs
scripts.predev: pnpm run native:electron && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/base build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/file-space build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-manifest build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-installer build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-state build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-surface-protocol build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-sdk build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-runtime build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/legacy-space-migration build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/electron-ipc build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/rawdata build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/client build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/graft-client build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/ext-server run build:assets
scripts.build: shx rm -rf dist-electron && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 EIDOS_SERVICE_MODE=desktop vite build --mode desktop
scripts.smoke:base-versioning: pnpm --filter @eidos.space/base build && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 SQLITE_USE_URI=1 electron scripts/base-versioning-smoke.mjs
scripts.smoke:graft-remote: cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 SQLITE_USE_URI=1 electron scripts/graft-versioning-smoke.cjs remote-conflict
scripts.smoke:file-extension-install: pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-manifest build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-installer build && node scripts/file-extension-install-smoke.mjs
scripts.presmoke:file-extension-app: pnpm run native:electron && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/file-space build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/electron-ipc build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/space-manager build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-manifest build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-installer build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-state build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-surface-protocol build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-sdk build && pnpm --filter @eidos.space/extension-runtime build
